title: Vercel April 2026 security incident
description: Vercel confirms breach originated from compromise of Context.ai, a third-party AI agent platform. Compromised employee credentials led to internal systems exposure.

title: this agent platform is the cause of the massive Vercel hack

title: Show HN: Optio – Orchestrate AI coding agents in K8s to go from ticket to PR

title: Show HN: Agent Package Manager (APM) for Agent Configuration
description: Microsoft/GitHub tool for managing agent dependencies and scanning for supply-chain attacks (hidden Unicode).

title: Windsurf Cascade Agent: Full Autonomy in Coding

title: Cloudflare Project Think: Dynamic Agent Workspaces
description: Cloudflare announces a stack for building agents with workspace, code execution, and dynamic tool registration (ExtensionManager). Agents can now register tools like github_create_pr on the fly.

title: AI coding agents accidentally introduced vulnerable dependencies
description: Incident report: 'Vibe coding' (Claude/Codex) led to pinning a vulnerable Next.js dependency (CVE-2025-29927), resulting in a production cryptominer installation.

title: CodeMachine-CLI: Automated Review Gates
